expo.name: Solid Connect

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Solid Connect uses your location to suggest your neighborhood, and shares it with your provider or customer only while a job is active.

plugins.photosPermission: Solid Connect needs access to your photos so you can attach pictures to requests, your portfolio and verification documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: Solid Connect uses your camera so you can take photos for requests, your portfolio and verification documents.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Solid Connect can use Face ID to unlock the app instead of typing your password every time.

expo.description: Find and book trusted local service providers in Ghana.
